## Efficacy

Zelvoran® (zelvoran) is indicated for the treatment of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in adults who are candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy.

In a 16-week randomised, placebo-controlled trial, 68.4% of adults treated with Zelvoran achieved PASI-75 compared with 9.2% receiving placebo [1].

In a second 16-week randomised, placebo-controlled trial, 44.2% of adults treated with Zelvoran achieved PASI-90 compared with 4.8% receiving placebo [2].

Among adults who achieved PASI-75 at Week 16, 64.8% maintained PASI-75 through Week 52 [3].
